cohort: The study included 400 postpartum women from Zahedan city, Iran, who had given birth between 6 and 24 weeks prior to data collection.
finding: In this cohort, 32% of postpartum women exhibited PTSD symptoms, and its prevalence was significantly associated with the mode of delivery, history of curettage, length of hospitalization, and unintended pregnancy.
mod_finding: A significant correlation was found between PTSD and the mode of delivery.
